items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: Camilla Todd she uh played with her with hippolyte Charles she played piano with us

ctx.x: what about did you ever uh play with Camilla Todd?

Camilla Todd she uh played with her with hippolyte Charles she played piano with us she was a great piano player oh yeah she's still living I don't believe yeah she's living but she's so skinny and so puny and all broad where is she? she's from uptown somewhere but she's still in the audience?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: So Camilla Todd said, Mr. Charles, won't you just bring your horn and lead on your lap?

ctx.x: No, I never heard of him. They haven't heard the name. Oh, he's a millionaire, yeah.

He, he was the head, he's the big man in the Standard Fruit Company, the Charlie Craft. Oh, I haven't heard of him. Crawford H. Ellis. He's got a big office in the Whitney building there. He's got a daughter, and, uh, she found fault about the band, cause Charles couldn't, Charles said he'd just come out the band and threw the flap sticks, you see? Beat them flap sticks? While we play, he just, he'd keep time with them flap sticks. So she said, the band don't sound like Mr. Charles, you know? And, uh, so he'd…
Yeah, I never heard him. Why couldn't he, uh, couldn't he play for his heart?
